# Amazon Q Developer - What is Amazon Q Developer? — captured 2026-07-04

## Core Capabilities
- Generative AI-powered conversational assistant; understand/build/extend/operate AWS apps
- Powered by Amazon Bedrock (with automated abuse detection)

## IDE Capabilities
- Chat about code, inline completions, generate new code, security vulnerability scanning, code upgrades/language updates, debugging, optimization

## Getting Started Methods
### AWS Apps and Websites
- AWS Management Console, AWS Documentation website, AWS website, AWS Console Mobile Application
### IDEs (Free with AWS Builder ID)
- Visual Studio Code, JetBrains IDEs, AWS Toolkit for Visual Studio, Eclipse IDEs (Preview)
### Chat Applications
- Microsoft Teams, Slack

## Pricing
- Free tier + Amazon Q Developer Pro

## Authentication
- AWS Builder ID (no AWS account for IDE) / IAM identity permissions

Updated: 2026-07-04 — No changes detected from previous scan. No reportable addition.
